lane: X1 (spacing sweep of the GEMSDOE32 champion rule). New this session; not one of the lanes listed in run_card_uwbp_drcs.json.
hypothesis: H-X1: For the GEMSDOE32 champion rule (H19-5 support, raster-order Euclidean thinning, visible-only collar d_vis>2), the holdout pooled DTI depends on the thinning spacing, so a spacing other than the incumbent 2.83 px may raise the HOLDOUT-DTI.
mechanism: Spacing trades coverage (more dots within 3 px of hidden truth, TP up) against false-positive mass (more dots, FP up at weight 0.2). The official alpha=0.2, beta=0.8 Tversky makes coverage cheap, so the optimum sits at the spacing where extra dots stop adding max-credit.
